name: Aerosmith

whyMatters.en: Boston five formed in 1970. Toys in the Attic (1975) and Rocks (1976) put syncopated hard-rock riffs on US FM; the 1986 Run-D.M.C. remake of Walk This Way and Permanent Vacation / Pump restored chart weight after the late-1970s collapse.
whyMatters.zh: 波士顿五人组，1970 年成立。《Toys in the Attic》（1975）与《Rocks》（1976）把切分 hard-rock riff 送上美国 FM；1986 年 Run-D.M.C. 翻唱《Walk This Way》，以及《Permanent Vacation》/《Pump》，在 1970 年代末低谷后恢复榜单重量。

lyricQuotes: Dream on / Dream on / Dream until your dreams come true
Walk this way / Talk this way

shortBio.en: Boston hard rock, 1970–. Toys in the Attic / Rocks peak; Perry exit then Run-D.M.C. Walk This Way and Fairbairn-era comeback.
shortBio.zh: 波士顿硬摇滚，1970 年至今。《Toys in the Attic》/《Rocks》高峰；Perry 离队后，Run-D.M.C. 的《Walk This Way》与 Fairbairn 期复出。

body.en:
Aerosmith formed in Boston in 1970 around Steven Tyler, Joe Perry, Tom Hamilton, and drummer David “Pudge” Scott; Joey Kramer replaced Scott and named the band. Ray Tabano briefly played second guitar before Brad Whitford joined in 1971. The 1973 debut Aerosmith mixed rock and R&B—sax from David Woodford stands out—and sold modestly. Get Your Wings (1974) used Brecker Brothers horns (also heard on Bruce Springsteen’s Born to Run) with producer Ray Colcord on keys; Jack Douglas soon took over production.

Toys in the Attic (1975) broke through on tour; Rocks (1976) and the reissued Dream On reached the US Top 10. Draw the Line (1977) kept momentum; Perry then left. Night in the Ruts (1979) used Richie Supa and Jimmy Crespo; Whitford later exited and Rick Dufay filled in for Rock in a Hard Place (1982). Drug debt nearly sank the band; Greatest Hits (1980) still paid Columbia millions.

Perry and Whitford returned; Done with Mirrors (1985) underperformed. In 1986 Run-D.M.C. remade Walk This Way with Rick Rubin—Tyler and Perry appear in the video. Permanent Vacation (1987) and Pump (1989), with Bruce Fairbairn, restored sales; tour horns/keys often came from Thom Gimbel (later Foreigner). Get a Grip (1993) and Nine Lives (1997) hit US No.1—Don Henley and Lenny Kravitz appear on the former; David Campbell (Kiss / Metallica string work) on the latter. I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing (1998, Armageddon theme) topped the singles chart. Later albums include Just Push Play (2001) and Honkin’ on Bobo (2004) with Jack Douglas back; Kramer said in 2011 they would not quit unless a member died.
body.zh:
Aerosmith 于 1970 年在波士顿组建，核心为 Steven Tyler、Joe Perry、Tom Hamilton，鼓手初为 David “Pudge” Scott；Joey Kramer 顶替 Scott 并取团名。第二吉他手 Ray Tabano 短暂在队，1971 年由 Brad Whitford 接任。1973 年首专《Aerosmith》混合摇滚与 R&B——David Woodford 的萨克斯突出——销量一般。《Get Your Wings》（1974）铜管有 Brecker 兄弟（亦参与 Bruce Springsteen《Born to Run》），键盘曾由制作人 Ray Colcord 担任；其后制作由 Jack Douglas 接手。

《Toys in the Attic》（1975）靠巡演打开局面；《Rocks》（1976）与二次发行的《Dream On》进入美榜前 10。《Draw the Line》（1977）仍有冲力，随后 Perry 离队。《Night in the Ruts》（1979）由 Richie Supa、Jimmy Crespo 补吉他；Whitford 后来离队，Rick Dufay 参与《Rock in a Hard Place》（1982）。吸毒与负债几乎拖垮乐队；《Greatest Hits》（1980）仍为哥伦比亚唱片公司带来数百万收入。

Perry 与 Whitford 回归后，《Done with Mirrors》（1985）成绩不如人意。1986 年 Run-D.M.C. 在 Rick Rubin 制作下翻唱《Walk This Way》，Tyler 与 Perry 出现在录影带中。《Permanent Vacation》（1987）与《Pump》（1989）在 Bruce Fairbairn 手下恢复销量；巡演萨克斯/键盘常由后加入 Foreigner 的 Thom Gimbel 担任。《Get a Grip》（1993）与《Nine Lives》（1997）登上美榜冠军——前者有 Don Henley、Lenny Kravitz；后者有曾为 Kiss、Metallica 做弦乐指导的 David Campbell。《I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing》（1998，电影《世界末日》主题曲）拿下单曲榜冠军。之后有《Just Push Play》（2001）与 Jack Douglas 回归的《Honkin’ on Bobo》（2004）；Kramer 2011 年说除非有成员去世，否则不会放弃乐队。

note.en: Debut-era piano ballad; 1976 reissue hit the US Top 10 with Rocks.
note.zh: 首专时期钢琴谣曲；1976 年再发与《Rocks》一并进入美榜前 10。

note.en: Syncopated riff from Toys in the Attic; 1986 Run-D.M.C. remake with Tyler/Perry.
note.zh: 出自《Toys in the Attic》的切分 riff；1986 年 Run-D.M.C. 翻唱，Tyler/Perry 参与。

note.en: Power ballad from Get a Grip (US No.1 album); MTV-era single.
note.zh: 出自美榜冠军专辑《Get a Grip》的 power ballad；MTV 期单曲。

title.en: Boston riffs, R&B pocket, FM length
title.zh: 波士顿 riff、R&B 口袋拍、FM 时长

body.en:
Early Aerosmith write hard-rock riffs over a funk-leaning rhythm section and Tyler’s high vocal. Toys in the Attic and Rocks are the strongest 1970s studio documents.

Dream On is piano ballad dynamics; Walk This Way is syncopation that later crossed into hip-hop radio.

Horns and keys (Breckers, Colcord, later Fairbairn brass) sit beside Perry/Whitford guitars on several LPs.
body.zh:
早期 Aerosmith 在偏 funk 的节奏组与 Tyler 高音之上写 hard-rock riff。《Toys in the Attic》与《Rocks》是 1970 年代最强录音室文献。

《Dream On》是钢琴谣曲动态；《Walk This Way》是后来进入 hip-hop 电台的切分写法。

若干专辑上铜管/键盘（Brecker 兄弟、Colcord，以及后来 Fairbairn 期铜管）与 Perry/Whitford 吉他并列。

title.en: Toys in the Attic to Draw the Line
title.zh: Toys in the Attic 到 Draw the Line

body.en:
Touring after Get Your Wings lifted Toys in the Attic (1975). Rocks (1976) and the Dream On reissue entered the US Top 10. Draw the Line (1977) followed before Perry’s exit.

Live! Bootleg (1978) documents the mid-decade stage run. Mick Jagger’s 1977 dismissal of the band (“garbage”) is often quoted against Slash’s later claim that nothing in the US was hotter than Aerosmith at their peak.
body.zh:
《Get Your Wings》后的巡演托起《Toys in the Attic》（1975）。《Rocks》（1976）与《Dream On》再发进入美榜前 10；《Draw the Line》（1977）之后 Perry 离队。

《Live! Bootleg》（1978）记录十年中期舞台。Mick Jagger 1977 年贬其为「垃圾」常被引用；Slash 后来回忆说当时美国没什么比 Aerosmith 更红。

alt.en: 1973 WMMS print ad — Mott the Hoople with Aerosmith
alt.zh: 1973 年 WMMS 印刷广告——Mott the Hoople 与 Aerosmith

body.en:
Crespo and later Dufay covered guitar while drugs and debt nearly ended the group. Greatest Hits (1980) still sold. After reunion, Done with Mirrors lagged; the 1986 Walk This Way remake with Run-D.M.C. put Tyler and Perry back on TV.

Permanent Vacation and Pump, produced with Bruce Fairbairn, rebuilt album sales. Get a Grip (1993) reached US No.1 with guests including Don Henley (Eagles) and Lenny Kravitz.

Cross-band thread: Henley on Get a Grip; Jimmy Page later tried to recruit Tyler toward a Led Zeppelin reboot—the band stayed intact.
body.zh:
Crespo 与后来的 Dufay 顶吉他，毒品与负债几乎结束乐队；《Greatest Hits》（1980）仍在卖。重聚后《Done with Mirrors》乏力；1986 年与 Run-D.M.C. 翻唱《Walk This Way》让 Tyler、Perry 重回电视。

Bruce Fairbairn 制作的《Permanent Vacation》与《Pump》重建专辑销量。《Get a Grip》（1993）美榜冠军，客串包括 Eagles 的 Don Henley 与 Lenny Kravitz。

跨乐队线索：Henley 参与《Get a Grip》；Jimmy Page 曾试图拉拢 Tyler 重启 Led Zeppelin——乐队未散。

body.en:
Syncopated guitar riff and Tyler vocal from Toys in the Attic.

Run-D.M.C.’s 1986 remake (Rick Rubin) put the same riff on hip-hop radio with Tyler and Perry in the video.
body.zh:
出自《Toys in the Attic》的切分吉他 riff 与 Tyler 人声。

Run-D.M.C. 1986 年翻唱（Rick Rubin）把同一 riff 送上 hip-hop 电台，Tyler 与 Perry 出现在录影带中。

title.zh: 1990 年代榜单高峰与后期目录

body.en:
Nine Lives (1997) also hit US No.1. I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing (1998) topped the singles chart as the Armageddon theme—Liv Tyler starring. Just Push Play (2001) leaned on studio tech; O, Yeah! Ultimate Aerosmith Hits (2002) outsold it.

Honkin’ on Bobo (2004) returned to R&B with Jack Douglas, Tracy Bonham, Johnnie Johnson, and the Memphis Horns. Kramer’s 2011 line: they would not quit unless a member died.
body.zh:
《Nine Lives》（1997）亦登美榜冠军。《I Don’t Want to Miss a Thing》（1998）作为《世界末日》主题曲拿下单曲榜冠军——女主角为 Liv Tyler。《Just Push Play》（2001）偏录音室技术；《O, Yeah! Ultimate Aerosmith Hits》（2002）销量更高。

《Honkin’ on Bobo》（2004）与 Jack Douglas 重回 R&B，另有 Tracy Bonham、Johnnie Johnson 与 Memphis Horns。Kramer 2011 年说：除非有成员去世，否则不放弃乐队。
